base_image_note: Official Rosetta Commons Docker image containing rc-foundry 0.2.0 and base-models model weights.

rf3.description: Latest RF3 checkpoint (trained with data through 01/2024)

build_gotchas: Upstream rosettacommons/foundry:0.2.0-weights omitted gcc/build-essential in its runtime stage. Under cuequivariance and triton, rf3 fold calls triton's JIT CudaUtils compiler (driver.c), raising 'RuntimeError: Failed to find C compiler. Please specify via CC environment variable'. Installing build-essential and gcc and setting CC=/usr/bin/gcc resolves this.

Apptainer runs the filesystem as read-only. Triton, HuggingFace, and Matplotlib attempt to write caches to root/home. All cache directories are redirected to /tmp (TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/triton, HF_HOME=/tmp/hf, XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/cache, etc.), which Apptainer mounts writable even under --containall.
Added solublempnn checkpoint so all three MPNN models (ProteinMPNN, LigandMPNN, SolubleMPNN) are available offline.

validation.note: Complete offline execution with isolated environment.
